Package gui

Class MainSelectionController

java.lang.Object
gui.MainSelectionController
public class MainSelectionController extends Object
Controller class for the Main Selection Screen. This screen allows the user to choose between Terminal Mode and Remote Access mode.

      private void switchScene(ActionEvent event, Parent root, String title)
      Utility method to switch the root of the current stage or create a new scene. Handles layout adjustments like full screen/maximized states based on the target screen.
